description: Third language: Private school body urges Karnataka to retain both AI and third language, warning that replacing languages could affect linguistic and cultural rights. The association seeks a common curriculum for all students under the SSLC board.
body_lead: Karnataka: Private schools’ body opposes govt decision to replace third language with AI Opposing the government's move, the association submitted a petition to Chief Minister D K Shivakumar and requested to have both AI and third language. Representative image of AI.
